helpText: The unique Settings Asset ID used by ItemFlavors. If you want to reference an ItemFlavor via playlist, just copy and paste the whole SAID00000000123 string.
Base value for Boost Type party requirement. Boost Events additionally can INHERIT the value chosen here.
Small text that only shows in Boost Panel UI (ex: 'MAX +300%')
The representative modifier amount text (ex: '100%' will want 100, '1.5x' will need '1.5').
If this is selected, it will tell the game to pull a seclection from the 'Favorites' list
If checked, will only be imported if sh_boost useDevBoosts is true
